archetype: Organic & Earthy modified for Vibrant Bright
design_philosophy: A highly optimistic, high-trust, and energetic e-commerce & MLM interface. Relies heavily on generous whitespace, vibrant lime green and sunshine yellow accents, grounded by deep forest green typography to maintain a premium feel. Avoids standard 'fintech dark' to emphasize growth, community, and fresh groceries.

buttons.primary: bg-[#84CC16] text-[#064E3B] font-semibold rounded-full px-6 py-3 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-[#FBBF24] text-[#064E3B] font-semibold rounded-full px-6 py-3 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-all

components.inputs: rounded-xl border border-[#E2E8F0] bg-[#FAFAF9] px-4 py-3 text-base text-[#334155] focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#84CC16] focus:border-transparent transition-all outline-none
components.nav_bar: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#E2E8F0]

motion.mlm_tree: framer-motion layout transitions for nodes, smooth zooming and panning functionality

iconography: lucide-react (stroke-width 1.5, rounded caps). Use green/yellow duotone where supported.
instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Generate pure .js and .jsx files (not .ts or .tsx).
Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs) have role-based data-testid attributes in kebab-case.
Use pure HTML+Tailwind for Landing Page sections. Do not constrain landing layouts with standard Shadcn card components; make them asymmetric and organic.
Use Shadcn UI components for User/Sub-Admin/Super-Admin Panels (tables, select, dialog, tabs). Customize radii to match rounded-2xl.
Implement an 8-Stage MLM Genealogy Tree using framer-motion and standard div nodes, connected visually.
Build the Income Calculator with interactive input[type='range'] sliders.
Maintain strict color hierarchy: Deep Forest Green for primary text over light backgrounds for maximum APCA contrast.
Never use pure white (#FFFFFF) for the main application background; use #FAFAF9.
Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or standard system fonts. Stick to Outfit (Headings), Plus Jakarta Sans (Body), and Space Grotesk (Numbers/Data).
